name: nitrogen
description: .ngr grammars and nitrogen.json workspace languages through nitrogen lsp.

nitrogen.server.path.description: The nitrogen executable (runs `nitrogen lsp`); empty runs the server bundled with the extension.

nitrogen.dotnetPath.description: The dotnet executable that runs the bundled server; empty finds it through DOTNET_ROOT, the standard install locations, and PATH.

scripts.test: esbuild src/otherExtensions.test.ts src/server.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outdir=out/test && node --test out/test/otherExtensions.test.js out/test/server.test.js
